recognize_zh: 高倍下一群有核仁、胞質多空泡的大型上皮樣細胞周圍，有三顆胞質塞滿粗大紫紅色異染性顆粒、核圓的肥大細胞，其中上方一顆顆粒部分散出（脫顆粒）。
features: Cluster of large epithelioid cells with round to lobulated nuclei, visible nucleoli, and finely vacuolated blue cytoplasm with knobby borders
Three mast cells with round nuclei partly obscured by coarse purple-red metachromatic granules
Degranulation with granules spilling into the background around the upper mast cell
Two small lymphocytes with dense nuclei
Small cell fragment with golden-brown material at upper left
describe_en: High-power view of a pleural fluid cytocentrifuge preparation shows a cluster of large epithelioid cells with round to lobulated nuclei, distinct nucleoli, and abundant finely vacuolated cytoplasm with knobby borders. Three mast cells with round nuclei and cytoplasm packed with coarse metachromatic granules surround the cluster, one showing degranulation. Two small lymphocytes are present. The epithelioid cells favor reactive mesothelial cells on morphology but metastatic carcinoma cannot be excluded without immunostains. Findings demonstrate mast cells in pleural fluid.

ddx.vs: Basophils have segmented nuclei and sparser, larger granules, whereas these cells have round nuclei with densely packed granules.
Neoplastic mast cells are often spindled and hypogranular with CD25/CD2 expression and KIT D816V, unlike these round well-granulated cells.
Adenocarcinoma cells form three-dimensional clusters with greater nuclear pleomorphism and are claudin-4/MOC-31 positive, calretinin negative.
